title: Sportswear HO19 / Shoe-wall rendering

location.series: Annie Nguyen / Nike Sportswear Core Holiday 2019

slide_intent: Distribute campaign elements through a retail space so shoppers can connect imagery with the products in front of them.
strategic_value: A central portrait and repeated messages can hold the Nike presentation together across merchandise and display furniture.
demonstration: A tall portrait panel stands between shoe walls and mannequins; two glazed towers carry white copy, and a central pedestal supports a shoe.
practical_value: Assign different jobs to the large central image, small product pedestal and repeated peripheral messages.

content_islands.name: Central image and pedestal
content_islands.spec: Align the tall portrait panel behind the small central product display.

content_islands.name: Merchandise
content_islands.spec: Place shoe walls and two dressed mannequins on either side of the center.

content_islands.name: Peripheral displays
content_islands.spec: Flank the scene with two glazed towers bearing the campaign message.

reference_purposes.Application: A tall portrait panel stands between shoe walls and mannequins; two glazed towers carry white copy, and a central pedestal supports a shoe.
